senses.gloss:
उच्छद् उच्-छद् (उद्-छद्), cl. 10. P. -छाद-
यति, -यितुम्, to uncover (one's body), undress.
उच्-छाद्य, ind. having undressed.

उच्छन्न उच्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम् (for उत्-सन्न by
a Prākṛt corruption?), destroyed.

उच्-छादन, अम्, n. (for उत्-सादन), cleaning or
rubbing the body with perfumes.

उच्छल् उच्-छल् (उद्-शल्), cl. 1. P. A. -छलति,
-ते, -लितुम्, to fly upwards or away, to move onwards.

उच्-छलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying up or away; going
or moving on or against.

उच्-छलन, अम्, n. moving upwards, going on or
against.

उच्-छालित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, waved, waved
above; gone; shaken.

उच्छास् उच्-छास् (उद्-शास्), cl. 2. P., Ved.
-छास्ति, -सितुम्, to clean or purify thoroughly.

उच्छास्त्रवर्तिन् उच्-छास्त्र-वर्तिन् (उद्-शास्त्र-
व˚), ई, इनी, इ, deviating from the law-books, trans-
gressing the ritual-books.

उच्छिख उच्-छिख, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् + शिखा),
having the flame pointed upwards; flaming, blazing
up; radiant; high-crested; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga
(‘with erected crest’).

उच्छिङ्घन उच्-छिङ्घन, अम्, n. (fr. उद्-शिङ्घ्),
breathing through the nostrils, snuffing, snoring; (the
word is also written उच्छिंहन.)

उच्छिद् उच्-छिद् (उद्-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -छि-
नत्ति, -छिन्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut out or off, extirpate,
destroy; to interfere, interrupt, stop: Caus. P.
-छेदयति, -यितुम्, to cause to extirpate or destroy:
Pass. -छिद्यते, to be cut off, stopped, or inter-
rupted; to cease, be deficient, fail.
उच्-छित्ति, इस्, f. extirpation, destroying, destruction.
उच्-छिद्य, ind. having cut off, destroyed, killed, &c.

उच्-छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut out or off; destroyed,
killed; abject, vile; (अस्), m. peace obtained by
ceding valuable lands.
उच्-छेत्तृ, ता, m. an extirpator, a destroyer.

उच्-छेद, अस्, m. cutting off or out; extirpation;
destruction; cutting short, putting an end to; excision.

उच्-छेदन, अम्, n. cutting off, extirpating, de-
stroying, destruction.
उच्-छेदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut off.
उच्-छेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destroying.

उच्-छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut off, to be de-
stroyed.

उच्छिरस् उच्-छिरस् (उद्-शि˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, hav-
ing the head elevated, with upraised head, N. of a
mountain also called Urumuṇḍa.

उच्छिलीन्द्र उच्-छिलीन्द्र (उद्-शि˚), अम्, n. a
mushroom.

उच्छिष् उच्-छिष् (उद्-शिष्), cl. 7. P. -छि-
नष्टि, -छेष्टुम्, to leave (as a remainder), to
reject: Pass. -छिष्यते, to be left remaining.

उच्-छिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, left, rejected, stale; having
the remains of food on the mouth or hands, one
who has not washed his hands and mouth and there-
fore is considered impure; (अम्), n. leavings, frag-
ments, remainder (especially of a sacrifice or of food).
—उच्छिष्ट-कल्पना, f. a stale invention.
—उच्-
छिष्ट-गणपति, इस्, m. (opposed to शुद्ध-ग-
णपति), Gaṇeśa as worshipped by the Ucchiṣṭas
or men who leave the remains of food in their mouth
during prayer.
—उच्छिष्ट-ता, f. the being left, state
of being a remnant or remainder.
—उच्छिष्ट-भो-
जन, अम्, n. eating the leavings of another man;
(अस्), m. one who eats another's leavings; the
attendant upon an idol, whose food is the leavings of
offerings.
—उच्छिष्ट-भोजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or उच्छिष्ट-
[]
भोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an eater of leavings, a mean
person.
—उच्छिष्ट-मोदन, अम्, n. wax.
—उच्छि-
ष्टान्न (˚ट-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, leavings, offal.

उच्-छेष, अस्, m. or उच्-छेषण, अम्, n. rest,
remainder; leavings.

उच्छीर्षक उच्-छीर्षक (उद्-शी˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the head raised; (अम्), n. a pillow (‘that
which raises the head’).

उच्छुष् उच्-छुष् (उद्-शुष्), Caus. -छोष-
यति, -यितुम्, to dry up, make dry.
उच्-छुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, dry, dried up, withered.

उच्-छोषण, अस्, आ, अम्, drying up, making dry;
(अम्), n. drying up, parching.
उच्छोषण उच्-छोषण. See उच्-छुष् above.
उच्-छोषुक, अस्, आ, अम्, drying up, making dry.

उच्छुष्म उच्-छुष्म, अम्, n. or उच्-छुष्मन्,
अ, n. (fr. rt. श्वस् with उद् ?), confusion.

उच्छूडा उच्-छूडा, f. (see the more correct
उच्-चूड), the head of a banner or part above the flag.

उच्छून उच्-छून, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्वि with
उद्), swollen, turgid; lofty, high; fat, bulky.

उच्छृङ्खल उच्-छृङ्खल (उद्-शृ˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, unbridled, uncurbed, unrestrained, perverse, self-
willed; irregular, desultory, unmethodical.

उच्छोचन उच्-छोचन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद्-शुच्),
Ved. burning.

उच्छ्रि उच्-छ्रि (उद्-श्रि), cl. 1. P. A. -छ्र-
यति, -ते, -छ्रयितुम्, P. to raise, erect, extol; A.
to rise, be erected.

उच्-छ्रय, अस्, m. rising, raising, erecting; eleva-
tion of a tree, mountain, &c.; rising of a planet, &c.;
height; growth, increase, intensity; the upright side
of a triangle.
—उच्छ्रयोपेत (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
possessing height, high, lofty, elevated.

उच्-छ्राय, अस्, m. rising upwards, elevation,
height; growth, increase, intensity; (ई), f. an up-
raised piece of wood, plank.
उच्-छ्रयण, अम्, n. raising, erecting.
उच्-छ्रायिन्, ई, इणी, इ, high, raised, lofty.
उच्-छ्रेय, अस्, आ, अम्, high, lofty.

उच्छ्लक उच्छ्लक, अस्, m., Ved. a part of the
human body, (used only in du.)

उच्छ्वङ्क उच्छ्वङ्क, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्वञ्च् with
उद्), Ved. gaping, cleaving open, forming a fissure.

उच्छ्वस् उच्-छ्वस् (उद्-श्वस्), cl. 2. P. -छ्व-
सिति, -सितुम्, to breathe, take a deep breath, sigh,
pant, respire.
उच्-छ्वसत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breathing hard, panting.

उच्-छ्वसन, अम्, n. breathing, sighing; taking a
deep breath.

उच्-छ्वसित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaving, beating, breathed,
inspired, blown, expanded; blooming, enlivened,
gladdened; (अम्), n. sighing.
उच्-छ्वसित; add — unfastened, untied.

उच्-छ्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, breathless, out of breath,
much, excessive, loosened, released, desisted from,
disjointed, divided.
उच्-छ्वासित; add — raised, lifted up.

उच्-छ्वास, अस्, m. breath, breathing, deep inspira-
tion; sigh; breathing out, expiring, dying; consolation,
encouragement; division of a book, pause in a narra-
tion; an air-hole.

उच्-छोथ (उद्-श्˚), अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्वि with उद्),
swelling, intumescence.
